name: lookoutvision
description: This is the Amazon Lookout for Vision API Reference. It provides descriptions of actions, data types, common parameters, and common errors.

subcommands.name: create-dataset
subcommands.description: Creates a new dataset in an Amazon Lookout for Vision project.

options.name: --project-name
options.description: The name of the project in which you want to create a dataset

options.name: --dataset-type
options.description: The type of the dataset. Specify train for a training dataset. Specify test for a test dataset

options.name: --dataset-source
options.description: The location of the manifest file that Amazon Lookout for Vision uses to create the dataset.

options.name: --client-token
options.description: ClientToken is an idempotency token that ensures a call to CreateDataset completes only once. You choose the value to pass.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: list-dataset-entries
subcommands.description: Lists the JSON Lines within a dataset. An Amazon Lookout for Vision JSON Line contains the anomaly information for a single image, including the image location…

options.name: --project-name
options.description: The name of the project that contains the dataset that you want to list

options.name: --dataset-type
options.description: The type of the dataset that you want to list. Specify train to list the training dataset. Specify test to list the test dataset.

options.name: --labeled
options.description: Specify true to include labeled entries, otherwise specify false. If you don't specify a value, Lookout for Vision returns all entries

options.name: --no-labeled
options.description: Specify true to include labeled entries, otherwise specify false. If you don't specify a value, Lookout for Vision returns all entries

options.name: --anomaly-class
options.description: Specify normal to include only normal images. Specify anomaly to only include anomalous entries.

options.name: --before-creation-date
options.description: Only includes entries before the specified date in the response. For example, 2020-06-23T00:00:00

options.name: --after-creation-date
options.description: Only includes entries after the specified date in the response. For example, 2020-06-23T00:00:00

options.name: --next-token
options.description: If the previous response was incomplete (because there is more data to retrieve), Amazon Lookout for Vision returns a pagination token in the response.

options.name: --max-results
options.description: The maximum number of results to return per paginated call. The largest value you can specify is 100.
